items.title: Generative fundus angiography from misaligned handheld images for non-invasive screening of infantile retinal diseases
items.excerpt: A generative AI model synthesizes fundus fluorescein angiography from misaligned handheld color fundus photos of infants, aiming to give dye-free visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities for screening infantile retinal diseases, a leading cause of childhood blindness.
items.rationale: Replacement pick: dye-free, needle-free angiography for infants generated from ordinary handheld fundus photos — a concrete patient-facing screening advance for childhood blindness, with no overlap in the 30-day history (the retinal items there were preeclampsia and adult CVD risk).

items.title: Validation of Computer Vision in the Operating Room for Ambient Documentation
items.excerpt: Stanford Health Care study in JAMA Surgery validates computer-vision ambient timestamp documentation (Aimbient) across a variety of operating-room procedures, reporting human-level accuracy for automated OR documentation. (Date from Crossref created; JAMA HTML behind Cloudflare.)
items.rationale: Peer-reviewed validation of camera-based ambient OR documentation at Stanford — extends ambient AI from the exam room to surgery; distinct from the Suki agentic OS product item.

items.title: 대구가톨릭대의료원, AI 음성인식 의무기록 '보이스 EMR' 고도화
items.excerpt: 대구가톨릭대의료원이 2024년 영상의학과·핵의학과에 도입한 AI 음성인식 의무기록 '보이스 EMR'을 고도화해, 진료 대화에서 의학적으로 의미 있는 정보를 선별하고 의료진별 서식에 맞춰 의무기록을 자동 생성하도록 했다.
items.rationale: Hospital deployment upgrade in Korea — voice EMR now filters clinically meaningful content and auto-fills clinician-specific templates; real care-site operations change.

items.title: Deep Learning Analysis of Korotkoff Sounds for Heart Failure Detection: A Prospective Multicentre Observational Study
items.excerpt: Prospective four-centre study of 1,103 cardiovascular inpatients in China: deep learning on Korotkoff sounds recorded during routine blood pressure measurement detected heart failure with AUC 0.924 in the independent test cohort, including NYHA class I patients.
items.rationale: Prospective multicentre result turning a routine BP cuff reading into a heart-failure screen (AUC 0.924, incl. NYHA I) — different modality and study from the 11-11 voice-change HF item.

items.title: Multimodal AI for bacterial vs viral upper respiratory tract infection multicentre development and internal validation
items.excerpt: A multimodal AI model fusing pharyngeal images with clinical data was developed and internally validated across multiple centres to distinguish Group A streptococcus pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory infections, aiming to guide appropriate antibiotic use.
items.rationale: Point-of-care diagnostic aimed at antibiotic stewardship (strep vs viral sore throat from throat photos + clinical data) — fresh, clinician-facing, adds a primary-care angle to the mix.

dedup.note: RE-PICK: dropped 데일리팜 'AI 가짜 의사·약사 광고 금지' (dailypharm.com/user/news/345052) as a cross-section duplicate. It is the same MFDS rule on AI-generated fake experts in ads that marketing already published on 2026-11-25 (etnews.com/20261124000360) and on 11-20/11-10. Replacement: npj Digital Medicine infant generative fundus angiography (s41746-026-03462-z). It is new: the closest history item is the 11-18 retinal preeclampsia biomarker, a different study and population. npj now has 2 of 5 picks, which is the per-outlet cap; there are 4 distinct outlets. Other candidates were skipped on judgement, not as duplicates: NEJM AI FDA sepsis tool (the brief says it is likely a 2024 erratum); AuntMinnie SCARLET-1 prostate MRI across 22 countries (I could not confirm it differs from the 2026-10-14 prostate-MRI item, so skipped as unsure); JBCR burn-resuscitation LLM (a close runner-up, but the excerpt gives no result and it would be a second academic.oup.com pick); Fierce weekly rundown (vendor roundup, and Gemini for healthcare was already carded 11-11); Innovaccer Grok Voice (vendor promo); STAT Epic (from HLTH on 11-18, stale); Healthcare Dive regulatory maze (explainer with no new action); Medigate MIRA (a secondhand write-up of a Nature paper, not checked against the science section); JAMA Health Forum workplace AI survey and Lancet DH AI-literacy review (less actionable); AAMC medical-AI education talk (a conference presentation); ICU CT body composition and ovarian phantom (lower priority). The 4 kept picks are unchanged.
